action: Contact Mark Thompson, the high school auto shop teacher, and propose a collaboration. Frank wants to explore teaching an adult continuing education course — working title 'Career Transitions and Skill Rebuilding' — through the school district's adult ed program. Frank's pitch: he has thirty years of experience breaking complex skills into learnable steps for anxious adults, he has a classroom voice, and he has firsthand knowledge of what it feels like to lose a livelihood to automation. Mark knows the district system and has the institutional relationships Frank lacks. Frank is not asking for charity — he is asking Mark to help him find the door into adult education and to co-sponsor or vouch for his application to the district's continuing education roster.
